query: SELECT j.created_at, jc.status::text AS status, (s.content IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.content) AS "same_test!" FROM v2_job j LEFT JOIN v2_job_completed jc ON jc.id = j.id LEFT JOIN script s ON s.workspace_id = j.workspace_id AND s.hash = j.runnable_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT content FROM script WHERE workspace_id = $4 AND path = $2 AND deleted = false AND archived = false ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) t ON true WHERE j.workspace_id = $1 AND j.runnable_path = $2 AND j.trigger_kind = 'ci_test' AND j.trigger = $3 ORDER BY j.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
